author: The Current
description:
runo plum performs at The Current Presents: Minnesota Music Month
Support The Current: https://support.mpr.org/youtube

On Friday, April 3, Minneapolis singer-songwriter runo plum and her band performed a discography-spanning set at the Amsterdam Bar + Hall in St. Paul. The set was part of The Current Presents Minnesota Music Month featuring: NUR-D, runo plum, and Agnes Uncaged with Special Appearances by jeremy messersmith, Singing Resistance Twin Cities, and the High School for Recording Arts Students.

Watch and listen to runo plum’s full set above.
